question: {Simplify } (2x - 1)² - (x - 4)(x + 4)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand both parts using algebraic identities:

(2x − 1)² → 4x² − 4x + 1

(x − 4)(x + 4) → x² − 16

Combine results: (4x² − 4x + 1) − (x² − 16)

Simplified form: 3x² − 4x + 17

**∴ Answer = 3x² − 4x + 17**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (2x − 1)² − (x − 4)(x + 4)

**Formula used:**

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

(a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²

 (2x − 1)² 4x² − 4x + 1 − (x − 4)(x + 4) x² − 16 Result: 3x² − 4x + 17 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Expansion of first part: (2x)² − 2(2x)(1) + (1)² = 4x² − 4x + 1

⇒ Expansion of second part: (x)² − (4)² = x² − 16

⇒ Subtracting second from first: (4x² − 4x + 1) − (x² − 16)

⇒ 4x² − 4x + 1 − x² + 16

⇒ (4x² − x²) − 4x + (1 + 16)

⇒ 3x² − 4x + 17

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
